messages:
marco (Sales): Heads up  Concord POC hit 413 when sending a single request with whole repo + embeddings. Customer wants guidance for tomorrow's demo.

Anya (Solutions): Can you paste the request size / curl? 413 usually gateway limit.

marco (Sales): They sent a ~4MB JSON (huge base64 & full text). curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d @concord_big.json
```
Response: 413 Request Entity Too Large; nginx log shows client_max_body_size exceeded.

Devon (Eng): Yep, gateway default at hosted is 2MB. We can: (A) advise client-side chunking with overlap, (B) upload to storage + send URL, (C) for Dedicated/POC we can temporarily raise limit.

marco (Sales): They want minimal changes. Prefer chunking. Any quick snippet?

Anya (Solutions): Suggested flow: split into sliding windows (~3-4k tokens), call embeddings or generation per window, then stitch results. Overlap ~100-200 tokens to avoid dropped context. Pseudo: 
```
windows = slide(text, size=4096, overlap=150)
out = [api.chat(window) for window in windows]
merged = simple_merge(out)
```
Works for demo.

Priya (Support): Note: Content-Encoding: gzip may reduce payload but decompressed size still matters. Some proxies reject gzipped bodies too. I'll open support ticket for an optional temporary gateway bump if they need a single-call demo.

ops-bot: Ticket #S-9820 created by Priya at 2026-03-25T09:12:03Z

Devon (Eng): Also remind them about model max context (e.g., 32k model will still truncate). We should add a friendly pre-check server-side that returns: "document exceeds max recommended context; try chunking or use Dedicated."

marco (Sales): OK I'll share chunking + overlap note and ask if they want the temp bump for the demo. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Anya (Solutions): If they prefer not to stitch on client, offer presigned upload flow example (quick server-side fetch). Works well for enterprise POCs.

marco (Sales): Cool. I'll update after customer reply.
